description: Read a single object from the shared Object Repository — its name, type, FULL locator bag (every captured strategy, e.g. playwright primary + xpath fallbacks), and how many test cases/functions/workflows currently reference it (so usage is visible BEFORE editing or deleting, not just discovered as a delete refusal after the fact). Requires a live connection (qa_connect).
name: object_get
title: Read one object (with all its locators)
